governance.constitution:

- Ensure that documentation, especially src/intent/*, is maintained and the existing document format is preserved.
- Ensure Refine remains "agent-first" by using installed coding-agent CLIs. Do not duplicate coding agent functionality.

result.summary: The plan addresses discoverable Goal name editing while preserving shared metadata rules and modal context.

checklist.description: Add an accessible Edit name control beside the Goal title and route it and the existing Rename menu action through one focused browser module that owns the name editor.

Prefill the editor with the current name, support Save and Enter, make Cancel and Escape dismiss only the editor, trim surrounding whitespace, show blank-name validation, and avoid saving an unchanged name.

Submit only the name through the existing Goal PATCH endpoint for the captured Goal and node context, retain server-authoritative metadata restrictions during Plan, Implement, Quality, and Governance, and prevent navigation from redirecting an edit or applying a stale response to another view.

Preserve the draft and editing focus across live refreshes of the same Goal, prevent duplicate submissions, retain failed edits with a visible retryable error, and refresh the authoritative title after success while preserving the surrounding modal context.
Update docs/intent/05-surfaces/03-browser/08-goal.md in its existing format to describe discoverable name editing and its shared metadata restrictions.

result.summary: Make the individual Goal modal's name editable beside its title so users can correct inaccurate or vague names through the existing metadata capability while preserving their work and modal context.

governance_precheck.message: Executing the finalized plan as written does not necessarily violate any supplied rule or enabled guidance.

checklist.evidence: Added accessible Edit name beside the Goal title; both it and the existing Rename action use the focused 150-line goal-name-editor.js module, loaded by index.html. Extracted the existing Chromium app harness into tests/support/browser_app.js without changing existing test bodies.

Editor prefills the current name, supports Save and Enter, trims surrounding whitespace, visibly validates blanks, and avoids unchanged-name PATCH requests. Cancel and Escape dismiss only the editor; normal dismissal restores focus to Edit name. Chromium interaction tests pass.

Sends only {name} through the existing Goal PATCH endpoint using captured Goal identity, node generation, URL and editor instance. Refreshes reject stale requests and old modal instances. Rust API regression verifies name trimming, blank rejection, preservation of other fields with the expected workflow revision increment, and unchanged durable records after rejection in Plan, Implement, Quality and Governance. Production Rust metadata behavior is unchanged.

Uses existing DOM morph preservation to retain the exact editor subtree, draft, caret and focus across same-Goal redraws. Prevents duplicate submissions, retains retryable failures, and retries failed post-save GETs without another PATCH. Success refreshes authoritative detail while preserving notes, Round drafts, expanded sections and underlying route. Chromium checks cover cancellation during save, navigation, node changes, out-of-order GETs, background failures and mobile layout.

Updated docs/intent/05-surfaces/03-browser/08-goal.md in its existing bullet format to document both entry points, editor interactions, draft preservation and shared metadata restrictions. Kept production changes within the existing browser surface and shared capability boundary.
